fingerprint.description: Algorithm/version-qualified normalised or approximate fingerprint. Exact equality supports correlation; approximate distance requires comparison.

metadata.description: JSON report with algorithm versions, preprocessing parameters, decoder version, timestamps and coverage limits.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of original input bytes (UTF-8 for text attributes).

description: Exact and versioned approximate content fingerprints with reproducible parameters and source provenance. Approximate matches are similarity candidates, not identity or attribution proof.
name: content-fingerprint
